url:https://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-.reason: FDA approval of zidesamtinib for previously treated ROS1+ NSCLC (decision itself; approval dated 22 Jul 2026, first surfaced by this monitor now).

practice_change.basis: FDA, 22 Jul 2026, zidesamtinib (Jideytro, Nuvalent) for adults with locally advanced/metastatic ROS1-positive NSCLC after at least one prior ROS1 TKI; rests on single-arm ARROS-1, efficacy population n=117, ORR 44% (per FDA announcement).

url:https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicin.reason: CHMP positive opinion for aumolertinib (first-line EGFR-mutated NSCLC); opinion date conflicts between sources (12 Nov 2026 vs a summary-of-opinion PDF dated 11 Dec 2025), so not rated practice-changing until verified.

url:https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/4163.reason: ASCO living guideline 2026.3.0 for stage IV NSCLC without driver alterations adds retifanlimab + chemotherapy; item does not detail other changes, so rated high not practice-changing.
